nodes.name: location_fk_cleanup
nodes.summary: Migration that backfills legacy location foreign keys on activities, lodging, and photo_albums into the unified EntityLink system, then drops the deprecated FK constraints, indexes, and columns.
nodes.languageNotes: Data-preserving migration pattern: inserts EntityLink rows via INSERT...SELECT before dropping the old FK columns, avoiding data loss during the schema cutover.

nodes.name: photos
nodes.summary: Adds media_type and duration columns to the photos table to support storing videos alongside images.

nodes.name: dismissed_validation_issues
nodes.summary: Creates the dismissed_validation_issues table so users can permanently dismiss trip health-check warnings per trip, with indexes for lookup and uniqueness per issue.

nodes.name: flight_tracking
nodes.summary: Adds departure/arrival delay and scheduled/actual timestamp columns to flight_tracking to support flight delay tracking.

nodes.name: missing_columns_backfill
nodes.summary: Defensive backfill migration that adds timezone, all-day, booking, and currency columns to lodging/activities, plus sunrise/sunset columns to weather_data, using IF NOT EXISTS guards for installations where they may already exist.

nodes.name: users
nodes.summary: Adds a use_custom_map_style boolean preference column to the users table, defaulting to true.

nodes.name: dietary_preferences
nodes.summary: Adds JSONB dietary_preferences columns to users and travel_companions, and a dietary_tags column to activities, to support dietary tracking across trips.

nodes.name: travel_documents
nodes.summary: Creates the travel document tracking system: travel_documents, visa_requirements, trip_languages, and language_phrases tables with supporting indexes for passport/visa records, per-trip language notes, and phrasebook entries.

nodes.name: users
nodes.summary: Adds bidirectional travel partner support via travel_partner_id and default_partner_permission columns on users (with a self-referential foreign key), and an exclude_from_auto_share flag on trips for automatic trip sharing.

nodes.name: users
nodes.summary: Adds a lookup index on users.travel_partner_id to speed up queries for a user's travel partner.

nodes.name: users
nodes.summary: Adds a password_version counter column to users, used to invalidate existing JWTs when a user changes their password.

nodes.name: users
nodes.summary: Adds per-user SMTP configuration columns (provider, host, port, secure, user, password, from address) to users for outbound email settings.

nodes.name: trip_series
nodes.summary: Creates the trip_series table for grouping related trips under a named series, and adds series_id/series_order columns plus a foreign key on trips to support ordered multi-trip series.

nodes.name: trip_types
nodes.summary: Adds a customizable trip_types JSONB list (seeded with default categories like Leisure, Business, Road Trip) to users, and trip_type/trip_type_emoji columns to trips for categorizing trips.

nodes.name: trip_tags
nodes.summary: Adds a sort_order column to trip_tags so tags can be manually reordered per trip.

nodes.name: trips
nodes.summary: Widens the trips.trip_type_emoji column from VARCHAR(10) to VARCHAR(50) to accommodate multi-codepoint ZWJ emoji sequences such as family emoji.

nodes.name: route_cache
nodes.summary: Replaces the non-unique route_cache lookup index with a unique index on origin/destination coordinates and travel profile to prevent duplicate cached route entries.

nodes.name: user_invitations
nodes.summary: Creates the user_invitations table to track pending/accepted/expired email invitations between users, with indexes for token lookup and status filtering.

nodes.name: cost_constraints
nodes.summary: Adds non-negative CHECK constraints on cost fields for activities, lodging, and transportation, and sets default values for trip status ('planning') and privacy level ('private').

nodes.name: email_imports
nodes.summary: Creates the email import pipeline schema: email_imports (raw forwarded emails and processing status) and pending_entities (AI-parsed entities awaiting user review), plus a forwarding-email index on users.

nodes.name: app_settings
nodes.summary: Creates a singleton app_settings table storing Gmail OAuth credentials and LLM configuration (base URL, API key, model) used to power the email import feature.

nodes.name: email_import_cleanup
nodes.summary: Removes the email import feature's schema: drops pending_entities, email_imports, and app_settings tables and the EmailImportStatus enum, reversing the earlier email import migrations.

nodes.name: pdf_imports
nodes.summary: Creates the PDF import pipeline schema: pdf_imports (uploaded PDF metadata and processing status) and a rebuilt pending_entities table (AI-parsed entities awaiting review), replacing the removed email import system with document upload.

nodes.name: llm_settings
nodes.summary: Adds per-user llm_api_key, llm_base_url, and llm_model columns to users, moving LLM configuration from the removed global app_settings table to individual user accounts.

nodes.name: migration_lock.toml
nodes.summary: Prisma migration lock file that pins the database provider to PostgreSQL, preventing accidental migration engine mismatches across environments.
